description: Today's macro briefing in one call: US Treasury yield curve with 10y-2y and 10y-3m spreads, recession and rate-path signals read in plain words, Fed funds, mortgage rates, breakeven inflation, the dollar index, oil and other public FRED series with 1-day, 1-week and 1-month changes, and policy rates of 10 major central banks. Use for market commentary, newsletters or context before a trade.
